review_title: S4 evidence review and original-journey recommendation
independence: The reviewer authored the short proof tests and did not implement the product delta. This is not an independent cold-author/E17/G4 acceptance claim.
verdict_explanation: The unchanged real causal probe preserves its workload, financial assertions, callbacks, isolation and SQL bytes while deterministic parse work falls materially. All 25 mission34 proof tests pass, including seven demand-materialization counterproofs. No new failure is observed. The complete S4 selection remains FAIL because its sole failure exactly matches B1 on the preimage.
authority_limits: This recommends the already requested original journey through the existing dispatcher. It is not merge, deploy, publication or closure approval, and does not replace the separate AGENTS typecheck/guard evidence.

native_work_explanation.nested_classification: First demand can legitimately move a native parse into the nested instrumented region. In this actual run it did not: total nested calls, total characters, tagged calls and tagged characters all exactly match S3 (issuer 72/747000, witness 48/498000). Root+nested comparison is also reported.
native_work_explanation.previous_conditional_hypothesis: The pre-log D=2/P=1 parse hypothesis was conditional, not an oracle. Actual measured decomposition is D=1/P=2, which explains 177/166 exactly.
native_work_explanation.result: Reduction is not explained by fewer Finance operations, fewer callbacks, skipped authorization, changed persisted data or relocation of work outside the observed scopes.
native_work_explanation.units: All parsed-character measures are UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes, heap usage or CPU cycles.

causal_probe.timing_limit: Elapsed times are one observation per causal operation on different CI runs, not a statistical speed guarantee. Work counts and exact result preservation are the causal evidence.
causal_probe.short_probe_limit: This passes omitted sensitivity and a confirmed issuer/witness 15000 operation. It does not prove confirmed sensitivity completion, witness 15001, replay, real restart or the original access sequence.
causal_probe.sql_equality_scope: Each run asserts exact SQLite snapshot bytes before and after the confirmed probe. Raw payloads are not emitted; cross-run raw byte equality is not asserted. The unchanged fixture, exact shape, operation counts and preserved financial assertions establish the comparable workload.

representative_profile.test: FIN-IND-005 persistence profile isolates real SQLite decode and staged snapshot work
representative_profile.interpretation: Cold Planner still validates all three new payloads: 3 tagged parses / 2105249 characters. Warm Planner reads 3923 native characters versus eagerAll 1245363, a reduction of 1241440. No tagged parses or descriptor traversal remain on either warm control. Warm Dashboard still allocates a fresh graph and parses 1241376 characters. Public decode and staged roundtrip paths remain controls; no claim of zero graph allocation is made.
representative_profile.scope_limit: This separate profile intentionally retains the W1 fixture preparation (1241296 state bytes, 10 results, 18 transactions). Its arms share one identical state; do not conflate its Dashboard size with the S3/S4 causal probe (1311209 bytes, 12 results, 20 transactions).
representative_profile.current_snapshots_limit: The scoped currentSnapshots measurement can include first-demand sibling materialization and is not a pure staged-clone-only cost after W3.

existing_regression_proofs.summary: All selected existing tests pass except the exact B1 mismatch; all W1 bounds and isolation proofs pass again.
verified_areas: False/throw/abort rollback and invalid state rejection
Cross-instance different-record writes and same-version CAS without callback replay
Nested write poison, active child rejection and scope expiry
Private blob generations, secret expiry/removal and fresh secret byte arrays
Corrupt or changed SQL payload validation before callback
Capture/restore with exact tagged state and rejected corrupt/missing blobs
C08 output isolation, mutable authority, cross-principal/request identity and revocation
Aggregate memo bound and accepted legacy fallback for oversized/deep/fixup/node limits
existing_regression_proofs.state_provider_caveat: The wp10 state-provider acceptance file uses its existing Map fixture and is supplementary; real SQLite proofs are separately present.
existing_regression_proofs.memory_caveat: The memo limit bounds retained immutable strings in the per-store Map, not heap/RSS. A live admitted root can temporarily retain a captured immutable plan after Map eviction. No shared mutable graph or authority is admitted by this optimization.

recommendation.action: Run the unchanged original Finance journey once on W3 after reconciling the head, through the existing surgical GitHub Actions dispatcher.
recommendation.reason: All requested short correctness counterproofs pass and the comparable real confirmed workload shows 162986537 fewer parsed characters across the two confirmed labels (56.34010399596884% root+nested reduction), with every measured operation/callback count and every asserted financial result preserved.
preserve: collaborator, outsider and revoked access assertions
recommendation.separate_required_gates: bun typecheck and AGENTS guards are not certified by this S4 review. Preserve and report their actual separate evidence; do not treat the S4 test job as those gates.
recommendation.stop_conditions: Any new original-journey failure must be reported and investigated without changing fixtures, oracles or timeouts.
recommendation.closure: FIN-IND-005 remains open until the original journey outcome is known. This review does not predict or assert its PASS.
